hold_text: THE MANAGER ASKED TO MERGE THIS BY HAND — verbatim in the MI-254 dispatch: 'Do NOT arm auto-merge and do NOT claim the merge slot — I merge by hand.' No arming file ships here and the merge slot is untouched. ⚠️ THE TIER IS 2 BY PATH, NOT BY CONTENT, and the two must not be conflated: the dispatch calls this Tier-1 read-surface work and that CONTENT judgement is correct — a read-only GET, no order path, no risk cap, no write surface added (POST /api/bot/work/decision is byte-for-byte unchanged, still token-gated and fail-closed). But pr-landing-guard grades by PATH and src/runtime/** and src/web/api/routers/** are Tier-2 under the src/** rule, so declaring tier 1 would fail R5. Field beats comment; the same correction this session already had to make on #11651. ⚠️ WHAT A HUMAN SHOULD READ: the behaviour change is that GET /api/bot/work/decisions now grades three requests differently, and its `summary.awaitingOperator` drops from 3 to 1 on the live store. That is a CORRECTION, not a suppression — the three rows are still returned, still visible, with their verdict, chosen, answered_at, answered_by and condition; only their STATE changed from 'waiting on you' to what they actually are. Nothing is hidden.
why: MI-254, operator-reported 2026-09-10: 'i do want to point out that the page doesn't seem to be very up to date - at least an hour old and I don't think all these decisions are still waiting for me'. The second half was a real defect and they were right. THE DEFECT: there are TWO recording shapes for one fact and the inbox knew one. POST /api/bot/work/decision writes an `answer` block; an answer given IN CONVERSATION -- how the overwhelming majority of decisions on this system are actually given -- is written by hand as `verdict` + `chosen` + `answered_at` + `answered_by`. grade_answer_state tested only `request.get('answer')`, so 'nobody has answered' and 'answered through the other channel' rendered IDENTICALLY. That is a collapsed state on the surface built to prevent collapsed states, and its cost is the panel's credibility, which is the entire point of the panel -- the desensitised-alarm P1 this repo files as its own bug class, with the operator telling us directly. MEASURED (population stated, re-derived in this session rather than inherited from the dispatch): every docs/claude/work/objects/*.yaml -- 21 objects carrying 26 decision_requests; 23 carry an `answer` block, 3 carry a `verdict` and NO answer block, 0 carry both. All three showed as `not_submitted` while carrying answered_at 2026-09-10T07:52:00Z. THE FIX IS AT THE ONE OWNER, deliberately: work_decisions.grade_answer_state, not a second predicate in the route or the SPA -- a second definition is free to drift, which is the same mistake as merging state/status, and this page already refused that. SEVEN never-collapsed states now, and the three added are each a distinct fact: `answered_in_conversation` (settled, but it never round-tripped, so it is NOT `committed` -- OI-20260901-DECISION-ROUNDTRIP-... turns on that distinction); `engaged_not_settled` (`reframed_not_answered` -- the operator responded WITHOUT settling, and folding this into answered would HIDE a genuinely open decision, which is worse than the bug being fixed); and `verdict_unrecognised` (we could not grade it -- a grader that shrugs at a value outside its vocabulary IS the collapse, which open_pr_record.VERDICTS states as its own rule). The terminal/non-terminal vocabularies share their spelling with open_pr_record.py where they overlap rather than being invented. ⚠️ `condition` IS CARRIED AND RENDERED: two of the three answered rows have a load-bearing one (that editing check_pr_landing.py is LANDING_MACHINERY so R12 still holds that PR for a human; and that the restart-gap tail is explicitly NOT addressed), and OPEN-PRS.json's doctrine is that a verdict recorded without its condition is WORSE than a missing row because it reads as complete -- dropping it would put that failure on the operator's own screen. Answered rows are SORTED LAST, never hidden: the operator needs to see what they decided and under what condition, and this page is the one surface they read. TESTS: 12 new, and the regression population is THE REAL OBJECT STORE, not a fixture -- a harness that never sees a verdict-without-answer row is exactly the gap that let this ship, so the last test reads docs/claude/work/objects/*.yaml directly with a positive control that it can find the shape before it reports on it. MUTATION-TESTED against BOTH wrong fixes: folding reframed_not_answered into answered (the error the dispatch explicitly warns against) fails 2 tests, and reverting to answer-block-only fails 6 including the real-store one. One pre-existing test asserted a literal `len(ANSWER_STATES) == 4`; it was rewritten to assert its INTENT (the states are distinct, the original four survive in order, and the added ones are not aliases) rather than weakened -- the count is what went stale, not the invariant. NOT IN THIS DIFF: the SPA rendering, which ships separately in ict-trader-dashboard and lands after this.
